source: United States Central Intelligence Agency, The World Factbook 2001
source_vintage_note: The book states that information generally available as of 1 January 2001 was used; selected content may have later updates.
method: Extract the country entry Languages field, preserve source wording, and collapse line wraps. Do not parse or normalize any percentages into population shares.
limitations: Factbook language coverage ranges from named languages to explicit estimates; it is not a uniform census series.
Kosovo, Montenegro, Serbia, South Sudan, and East Timor do not have separate country entries in the 2001 source; no parent-country language field is represented as a territory-specific estimate.
Antarctica has an entry but no Languages field.
The 2001 source table supplements but does not replace the existing game language-share profiles in country_languages.toml.
